{{Quote|We're talking about the fabled Sadow'een. Naga Sadow's personal order of assassins&mdash;myth made real!|[[Talos Drellik]] to [[Darth Nox|Kallig]]|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
The '''Sadow'een''' were a secret order of [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] who served the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]].

==History==
During the reign of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], they were responsible for dispatching their master's enemies. At some point, they established a [[Sadow'een Temple|temple]] in the [[Glacial Fissure]] area of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The Sadow'een were responsible for killing Sadow's rival [[Horak-mul]] at the start of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], though his [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] managed to survive. The assassins were entombed in the temple after their work was finished.<ref name="SWTOR" />

By the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the Sadow'een Temple was reduced to ruins, with only the catacombs surviving largely intact, though Naga Sadow's ancient [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] continued their patrols. Members of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith]] [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] did not seriously consider Hoth as a location for the temple until the arrival on the ice planet of [[Darth Zash]]'s [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Darth Nox|Kallig]]. The [[Sith Inquisitor]], together with [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Talos Drellik]] of the Reclamation Service, [[Reclamation Service Hoth expedition|visited]] the temple in search of Horak-mul's sarcophagus. The long dead Sith Lord contacted them and offered his power to the Inquisitor on the condition that the latter defile the tomb of the Sadow'een, avenging the Sith Lord's death.<ref name="SWTOR" />
